findings: R1 defect A: entities.js stepEntities() hold_ground branch does `e.alert = min(100, e.alert+4)` — flat, never multiplies by sim.stealth.p.V. This is the coupling-0 call site.
R1 defect B: stealth/system.js step() §5 loops civilians only; no witness derivation, no sound propagation into civilians (only emitSound() discrete events).
R1 defect C: no occlusion anywhere; p.inCover is an authored boolean A=0.80.
R1 defect D: search.js Search/ZoneMemory never instantiated by the step (this.searches = [] is never pushed to).
R1 defect E: engine.takeObject() sets obj.stolen_from on the DATA record but never adds to an inventory or crime.stolen_registry; save/state.js has no stolen registry.
R1 defect F: no guard entities exist; getGuardBand() is a pure function of setBounty().

CRITICAL: sim/entities.js stepEntities() is DEAD CODE — never called from step.js. The LIVE perception call site the critic was looking for is combat/enemy.js::_idleBehaviour line ~222: `if (sees || b.aggro) this.alert = Math.min(100, this.alert+4)`. combat-bridge.js mirrors ec.alert -> e.alert every frame.
Perception is now owned by ONE module: game/src/sim/stealth/perception.js, called from stealth/system.js stepPerception(). combat/enemy.js no longer fills the meter; it reads it.

MEASURED after the fix, RI-STL01 method 2 (inf_trash at 8 m, R=16): r2 4.00s vs item 3.94 (1.52%), r3 8.50 vs 8.5 (0.00%), r4 26.667 vs 26.7 (0.12%). r1 within sampling granularity of 1.03. Coupling is no longer 0.
inf_trash sight_radius_m moved 14.0 -> 16.0 (RI-AI01 §B nominal INFANTRY; ±2 tolerance). RI-STL01 §2's worked table is computed at R=16.

CORPUS CONFLICT FOUND: RI-AI01 §B states the primary sight rate as '100/s at <=0.5R, 50/s at 1.0R'; RI-STL01 §2's worked table implies 75/s at 0.5R (97.5 = 150*1.30*0.5). Irreconcilable. Build uses RI-STL01's form (its method 2 asserts against that table). Filed for the bar critic.
detection.json peripheral_rate_scale corrected 0.45 -> 0.35 (RI-AI01 §B). Added hearing_rate_per_s {60,40,25,0}, hearing_wall_attenuation 0.4, peripheral_alert_cap 70 — all RI-AI01 §B verbatim.

LOS uses sim.cell.sphereCast() — the SAME static collision set the camera spring arm and player body use — plus a stealth scratch occluder cell. r=0.05 m probe (r=0 makes conservative advancement degenerate).
Stepping 1 frame at a time over the playwright bridge is far too slow (>120 s for 2 rows). Probe loops must run inside page.evaluate().

QuestBook enforces journal-index integrity at boot: every resolution's journal_index must exist in the quest's journal. Adding a resolution WITHOUT a journal entry breaks the boot for every agent. Fixed by authoring 12 journal entries.
snapshot() builds a whole trace record; a 3600-frame per-frame curve needs the cheap perceptionState() accessor instead (added).
VERB-SPREAD after the quest work: 24.7% (cap 40%). sneak 13 quests / 33, steal 8 / 33.

PERF: the probe at 1920x1080 under SwiftShader is ~60x slower than at 320x240 — a 3600-frame in-page loop went from >20 min to 2.9 s. Every W1-15 probe must pass --width 320 --height 240 unless it screenshots (NO-METER does, and only that one needs the full viewport).
MEASURED row 1 at the small viewport: AGGRO at f=62 vs the item's 1.03 s (61.8 f) — 0.32% error, V=1.30.

ROOT CAUSE of the slow probes: Engine.stepFrames() ends with `if (loop.renderRateHz !== 0) loop.renderNow()`. A per-frame probe loop therefore draws one SwiftShader frame per SIM frame. Measured: 600 bare sim frames = 71 ms; 600 frames driven one-at-a-time with the renderer live never returned and killed the page. Fix: H.setRenderRate(0) before any stepping loop. This is worth telling every other builder/critic in the project.
